balance.rounding: truncate fractional rubles for display; never round source amount

prototypeLimitations.note: Prototype reserve, not a product digit limit; general-width requirements need additional boundary tests

status: Specification update; adaptive font sizing is not implemented by this documentation change

legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.target: measure actual formatted target with current typography + currency gap + currency cell
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.digitCount: from amount data; not fixed at five or six
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.grouping: from active formatter; align separators by decimal place during transition
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.transitionReserve: derive from current visible amount and new target; exclude empty cells from final width
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.center: centre of available container after padding; 201px is only the 390px demo
legacyPrototypeAmountLayout.status: Archived 2026-10-22; moving eye and fixed typography are not v4 requirements

amountLayout.overThreshold: start reduction; never truncate digits to 12 characters
amountLayout.measurement: actual formatted amount and currency at effective font size within reserved text slot
amountLayout.overflowAtMinimum: right-edge fade in text slot only
amountLayout.blockHeight: fixed by layout, independent of amount
amountLayout.reducedMotion: final number immediately; same font fit and fade rules
